text:
Maya: quick idea 1: run DP recruiting as an \"hourglass\": tight 2-week early-commitment pilots (small N) to surface issues fast, then open wider waves. simple and experimental.
Sam: sounds practical. what's the exact gate from pilot -> wave?
Maya: gate = three checks: stability, perf, and partner engagement. non-negotiable tech metrics + a short AE signoff.
Alex: propose machine-readable gate so we can automate dashboards. brief sketch: ```pilot_n=6; stability_errors_pct<1; p95_latency<450ms; engagement>=3 weekly flows; qual_ok=true```
Priya: love machine-readable. also suggest micro-incentives: $500 dev credits + featured case study call if partner stays past pilot. reduces churn.
Owen: ops question: rollback plan for partner regressions? need clear automated fallback + who to notify.
Maya: plan: per-partner canary flag. if regression delta > threshold -> auto rollback to previous model + page oncall. link to runbook when ready.
Lina: feedback cadence: 2 channels: 1) weekly 30m syncs during the 2-week window, 2) in-app 2-question micro-survey after critical flows. telemetry: prefix latency, tokens per session, and top 5 error messages.
Sam: we should also require 10 canonical prompts from each partner. run blind A/B evals each rollout; block if quality delta > 3 pts (metric = partner-specified rubric).
Alex: timeline idea: Week0 invites (6); Week2 pilot review; Week4 waveA (25); Week8 scale. engineering capacity could compress by 1 week per stage if we pre-clear infra.
Priya: outreach copy note: call the 2-week trial an \"early-commitment period\". upfront expectations make churn lower. I'll draft copy + sample success bullets.
Owen: runbook action: I'll draft fallback automation and oncall flow. tie to existing deploy-bot alerts.
Maya: NDA? pros/cons. leaning no NDA for the tiny early pilots (less friction), require one starting waveA+.
Sam: +1 to light TOS & feedback consent for pilots.
Alex: action items:
- Maya: finalize hourglass playbook + acceptance matrix (EOD Thu)
- Priya: draft outreach + incentive package + micro-survey (Mon)
- Owen: fallback automation + runbook draft (Fri)
- Lina: telemetry spec + dashboard fields (Thu)
- Sam: assemble pilot invite list + check-in calendar (Tue)
Maya: tagging @deploy-bot to create recurring DP check-in event.
deploy-bot: created series \"DP Early-Commitment Check-in (30m)\" and invited Maya, Sam, Priya, Alex, Owen, Lina. :calendar:
Sam: one more point 1: gating should be engineering-metric-first for release safety, but prioritize partner qualitative signal for product direction.
Maya: agreed. we'll gate launches on infra/perf, but let partner voice steer feature scope and prioritization.
Priya: I'll include a simple scoring sheet for AE signoff (stability, value, integrability, willingness to continue).
Owen: ok to close after Maya posts final matrix. thanks all. :thumbsup:
